query:
UPDATE books
            SET series_order = CASE
                    WHEN ? IS NULL THEN NULL
                    WHEN series_id IS ? AND series_order IS NOT NULL THEN series_order
                    ELSE (
                        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(b2.series_order), 0) + 1
                        FROM books b2 WHERE b2.series_id = ?
                    )
                END,
                series_id = ?
            WHERE id = ?
